annotations.title: Check eligibility for ShyftOff remote work

description: Quick self-check against ShyftOff's published requirements for remote customer service agents: 18 or older, in the US, a modern computer, a USB headset, wired internet at 25 Mbps+, and a quiet private space. No experience required. Takes only yes/no answers to those requirements (never an age, location or other personal details) and stores nothing. Returns what's met, what's missing with how to fix it, next steps and David's referral sign-up link. Pass only the yes/no answers the person has given; unknown items are listed for them to confirm.

has_computer.description: Has a modern computer (many programs ask for Windows 11 with 8 GB RAM).

has_quiet_space.description: Has a quiet, private place to work.

has_usb_headset.description: Has a USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone.

in_us.description: Whether they're in the United States (yes/no only; don't pass a state or city).

internet_mbps.description: Internet speed in Mbps, if known.

is_18_or_older.description: Whether the person is 18 or older (yes/no only; don't pass an age).

name: check_eligibility
title: Check eligibility for ShyftOff remote work
